posts.author: UTAS
posts.body: Hi, my name is Graham. I experimented with RPG Maker 2000 many years ago. Now I write and design tabletop games. I'd drop a link, but I'm worried about etiquette here. I am very curious to see what games are being made these days!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome!
I don't know all the specific rules about sharing links. I think it gets a bit nuanced. I know that my link to my YouTube channel is OK and you can definitely see links in other people's signature areas.
I am old enough to remember when TTRPGs were new and D&D was a fledgling thing, filled with controversy.
Long live the TTRPG Makers!
Good luck and enjoy your time here.
